Something like

library(gridExtra)

plot1 <- qplot(...)
plot2 <- qplot(...)
plot3 <- qplot(...)

grid.arrange(plot1,plot2,plot3,nrow=1)

(The beginning of the ?grid.arrange page is a bit confusing but the
examples are very good.)
